case_selection: SHA256-sorted active/active second-agent CALIBRATION prompts indices 112:176; 0:48 ML-081, 48:112 ML-082

grid.11: second patient (joint target, not used for composition)

composition: h10 + h01 - h00, final-token component at one site
primary_per_seed_measure: four-choice target-hit for composition minus target-hit for cyclically shuffled role delta normalized to composition norm; report all 8 seeds by exposure arm, no post hoc seed exclusions
controls: true h11 direct joint donor (positive reference; not a test of additivity)
event-only h10 and role-only h01 (not norm matched)
h10 + role delta from a different sentence, normalized to composition norm
h00 + event delta - role delta, normalized to composition norm
3 independent isotropic Gaussian perturbations normalized per-example to composition norm
extra_metrics: all condition-specific patch norms and candidate-hit rates
interpretation: Same-model exploratory calibration, not unseen grammar or independent model testing. Successful composition tests a manipulation of final-token states, not native necessity or a grammatical algorithm; successful shuffled controls may indicate context-general transformations rather than failure. The two apparent addition orders are algebraically identical.
result_rule: freeze and commit script plus generated protocol before evaluate; do not overwrite existing result file; no protected cases
